label: Journal sync
title: Timetable → journal synchronisation
note: A stable source key and a scoped upsert update imported lessons instead of creating duplicates.

label: Room mapping
title: Normalising external room names
note: Different room labels are normalised before looking up an active classroom.

label: Session timing
title: Time boundaries + session identity
note: A lesson is active from its start until, but excluding, its end. Session identity also checks classroom, group and start time.

label: Commissions
title: Sales → commission ledger
note: Sale and team-override entries have separate types. Conflicts on lead, user and type are ignored on repeated calls.

label: Access rules
title: Role-aware lead access
note: This helper allows admins, owners and team leads whose direct report owns the lead.

label: Reactivation
title: Follow-up rules for lost leads
note: Do-not-contact blocks reactivation. Other reasons use a cooldown or a validated future follow-up date.

label: Seat session
title: Check-in → versioned state
note: A seat session is created using UTC timestamps, the classroom version increments and the new state is returned.

label: State version
title: A compact classroom version endpoint
note: The client can request a version and update timestamp without receiving the full classroom state.

label: Check-in rules
title: Roster + existing-session checks
note: The request checks the active roster and existing open sessions before creating a check-in.

label: Overlap check
title: Programme interval validation
note: Strict interval comparisons reject overlapping programmes while allowing adjacent programmes to share a boundary.

label: TV day
title: A broadcast day starts at 06:00
note: The service builds a 24-hour interval from 06:00 on the selected date to 06:00 the following day.

label: End times
title: Programme ends derived from the next start
note: The display end time uses the next programme start, falling back to the original end time when there is no next programme.

label: Fuzzy match
title: Diacritics + typo-tolerant answers
note: Answers are normalised, compared for inclusion and checked with a bounded Levenshtein distance.

label: Normalisation
title: Making Latvian answers comparable
note: Latvian diacritics, punctuation and repeated spaces are normalised before comparing player answers.
code:
export function normalizeLatvianText(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[āáàâä]/g, 'a')
    .replace(/[čç]/g, 'c')
    .replace(/[ēéèêë]/g, 'e')
    .replace(/[ģğ]/g, 'g')
    .replace(/[īíìîï]/g, 'i')
    .replace(/[ķ]/g, 'k')
    .replace(/[ļ]/g, 'l')
    .replace(/[ņ]/g, 'n')
    .replace(/[šś]/g, 's')
    .replace(/[ūúùûü]/g, 'u')
    .replace(/[žźż]/g, 'z')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}
